architecture_findings: PHOENIX-PROTOCOL-ULTIMATE presents itself as a consolidation point for multi-AI coordination, distributed memory, verification/timestamps, web interfaces, deployment, tests, and research, while explicitly retaining an evidence boundary for independent reproduction.
ZYGROS-PRIME contains a controlled-experiment lineage: static control versus adaptive system, fixed initial conditions, intervention restrictions, comparative metrics, and publication criteria.

omega-10 is the clearest evidence-substrate layer: canonical serialization, SHA-256 hashing, append-only JSONL ledger/hash chaining, Ed25519 signing, manifests, recovery benchmarks, red-team fixtures, and bounded HTC mode; its README explicitly separates implementation/local evidence from independent reproduction.

omninet-v4 contains a research-oriented falsifiability layer with deterministic tests, resilience scoring, effect sizes, confidence bounds, fault injection, and a recovery-decay null model; it explicitly warns that experimental mathematical models are not established scientific laws.

multi-ai-convergence-protocol defines a central synchronization/deliberation architecture and explicitly requires current implementation, tests, integration fixtures, dependency/security review, and provenance before verification or production claims.
conzetian-skill-lattice acts as a capability/skill abstraction and treats the public web as a discovery substrate, but this is an architectural role rather than proof of perpetual live connectivity.
CZAOUA-UNITY-SYSTEM is a compact integration specification emphasizing recursive evolution, swarm orchestration, HTC, and portability; its stronger claims require executable evidence.

The federation layer now supplies a machine-readable cross-repository graph and shared action contract. This creates logical integration edges but does not create live daemons, credentials, MCP/A2A endpoints, or continuous synchronization.

The corpus has substantial archival duplication and nested documentation artifacts, especially in ZYGROS-PRIME, PHOENIX-PROTOCOL-ULTIMATE, and Sovereign-AGSI-Archive. This is useful for lineage but complicates capability deduplication and current-state analysis.
conzetian-method is currently zero-sized in the connected GitHub inventory, so it is a federation node but contains no repository payload to analyze at this revision.
